# RoyaleGym

> Train Clash Royale bots with reinforcement learning, in Python. Five packages: RoyaleSim (the
> battle engine, Rust with Python bindings), RoyaleGym (the environment, built from configuration
> objects: StateMutator, ObsBuilder, ActionParser, RewardFunction, termination and truncation
> DoneConditions), RoyaleLearn (the PPO trainer), RoyaleViser (the viewer) and RoyaleImitate
> (record battles and clone a bot from them, warm start from a trained bot, and a penalty that
> keeps a new bot near it). Not on PyPI yet. Install everything with
> `pip install "royalegym[all]" --find-links https://github.com/RoyaleGym/RoyaleGym/releases/expanded_assets/v0.1.7`
> (Python 3.12, 3.13 or 3.14). On Windows, install CUDA PyTorch first with
> `pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128`. Training assumes an
> NVIDIA GPU; Macs need Apple silicon. The engine's battle logic is still being matched to the
> real game; the Python APIs are meant to stay put.

RoyaleSim and RoyaleViser also have an AGENTS.md at their repository root with their layout,
build and test commands, and the rules their tests enforce.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/): a map of the site, the five packages, Discord, GitHub and Ko-fi
- [Introduction](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/introduction/): what it is, quick answers, the five packages
- [Install](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/install/): Python, a virtual environment, PyTorch, the install line, a check
- [Quick Start](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/quickstart/): one file, build_env() plus Learner(...), that trains a bot; its output, watching, stopping, decks
- [FAQ](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/faq/): computer, training, decks, testing and sharing a bot, updating
- [It Doesn't Work](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/it-doesnt-work/): error messages and their fixes
- [How It Fits Together](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/overview/): the configuration objects, the two seats, what happens in one step

## Clash Royale

- [Training an Agent](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/clash-royale/training-an-agent/): custom rewards, every trainer setting, self-play, decks, watching, wandb
- [Configuration Objects](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/clash-royale/configuration-objects/): what each swappable part of a battle does
- [Action Parsers](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/clash-royale/configuration-objects/action-parsers/): the 2305 moves, the action mask, ability buttons, writing one
- [Done Conditions](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/clash-royale/configuration-objects/done-conditions/): termination vs truncation, the shipped ones, writing one
- [Observation Builders](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/clash-royale/configuration-objects/observation-builders/): the spatial observation, fair information, Reveal, writing one
- [Opponents](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/clash-royale/configuration-objects/opponents/): scripted bots, evaluate(), ClashGymEnv
- [Reward Functions](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/clash-royale/configuration-objects/reward-functions/): the shipped rewards, CombinedReward, writing one
- [State Mutators](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/clash-royale/configuration-objects/state-mutators/): decks by name, evolutions and heroes, mid-game starts, writing one
- [Viewer](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/clash-royale/configuration-objects/viewer/): watch training live, save and open a battle, keys

## Cheatsheets

- [Game Values](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/cheatsheets/game-values/): arena, ticks, elixir rates, towers, codes, the action formula, card names, evolutions and heroes, the card list
- [Reinforcement Learning Terms](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/cheatsheets/rl-terms/): plain-language definitions

## Additional Resources

- [RoyaleSim](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/resources/royalesim/): the engine, determinism, driving it directly
- [RoyaleLearn](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/resources/royalelearn/): every Learner setting with its default, checkpoints, using a trained bot
- [RoyaleViser](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/resources/royaleviser/): the viewer
- [RoyaleImitate](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/resources/royaleimitate/): warm start and stay-close training
- [royalegym API](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/reference/royalegym/)
- [royalelearn API](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/reference/royalelearn/)
- [royaleviser API](https://royalegym.github.io/RoyaleGym/reference/royaleviser/)
